Guideline Note:

8/1/2026  
 
 
 
 
1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Brand Xeljanz tabs, generic tofacitinib tabs, Brand Xeljanz XR tabs, generic 
tofacitinib ER tabs  
Diagnosis 
Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA)  
Approval Length 
12 month(s)  
Therapy Stage 
Initial Authorization  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - Diagnosis of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis (RA)  


--- PDF page 1914 ---
UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1914 
 
AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting history of 
failure to a 3 month trial of methotrexate at the maximally indicated dose within the last 6 
months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced  
 
AND 
 
3 - Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist  
 
AND 
 
4 - ONE of the following:  
 
 4.1 If the request is for generic tofacitinib tablets, trial and failure or intolerance to Brand 
Xeljanz tablets  
 
OR 
 
 4.2 If the request is for generic tofacitinib ER tablets, trial and failure or intolerance to Brand 
Xeljanz XR tablets  
 
Product Name:Brand Xeljanz tabs, generic tofacitinib tabs, Brand Xeljanz XR tabs, generic

UnitedHealthcare Community Plan of Arizona – Clinical Pharmacy Guidelines 
Page 1919 
failure to ONE of the following conventional therapies at maximally indicated doses within the 
last 3 months, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced:  
• 
Corticosteroids (e.g., prednisone, methylprednisolone, budesonide)  
• 
6-mercaptopurine (Purinethol)  
• 
Azathioprine (Imuran)  
• 
Aminosalicylates (e.g., mesalamine, sulfasalazine)

AND 
 
2 - Submission of medical records (e.g., chart notes) or paid claims documenting trial and 
failure, contraindication, or intolerance to ONE of the following nonbiologic disease-modifying 
antirheumatic drugs (DMARDs):  
• 
leflunomide  
• 
methotrexate
